name: kestrel-gives
description: Kestrel Gives: a charity auction web app, recreated from memory as a case study in designing and building with AI.

scripts.build:vercel: npm run build && node scripts/check-seed-base.ts && npm run check:types && env -u DATABASE_URL -u BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN npm run test:rules && node scripts/deploy-db.ts
scripts.check:types: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && node scripts/check-vercel-ts.ts
scripts.check:a11y: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts tests/e2e/keyboard.spec.ts tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/browse.spec.ts tests/e2e/item.spec.ts tests/e2e/item-actions.spec.ts tests/e2e/submit.spec.ts tests/e2e/your-items.spec.ts tests/e2e/proof.spec.ts tests/e2e/admin.spec.ts tests/e2e/loading.spec.ts
scripts.check: npm run check:deps && npm run check:seed-images && npm run check:tokens && npm run check:types && npm run test:rules && npm run test:db && npm run check:a11y && npm run check:reflow && npm run check:visual
